# SANDY PARK
for BERKELEY SCHOOL BOARD 2026
This November, I’m running for the Berkeley Unified School District Board of Directors. I am honored to be endorsed by the Berkeley Federation of Teachers (BFT).
I have 25+ years experience working as a public school educator, administrator, and consultant. My three children attend Berkeley public schools. And I am an active community organizer. This unique combination of perspectives means I understand the daily realities of our classrooms, the complexities of district-level policy, and the lived experiences of our BUSD families.
My priority is to demystify the School Board, building a culture of shared decision-making — where data is accessible, diverse voices are valued, and dissent is respected. By centering the real, daily needs of our students, families, and staff, we can collaboratively protect student-facing services while building a district accessible to all.
I need your support and there are several ways to help. Please consider endorsing this campaign and volunteering to help spread the word. THANK YOU!
ENDORSE and VOLUNTEER
